FX-SHARPEN-001.says: Amount 100 and radius 1, the settings as they start: each colour is pushed away from the blurred colour around it, so the two sides of every edge inside the box move apart. The line, dark beside the skin, is pushed to black all round the box and down the soft column 7; the skin beside the line grows lighter, its red held at 1; the skin beside the band loses blue, and the band loses red and green and gains blue. Every pixel of the box and of the soft line changes; the patch of skin on the left, with its soft edge, has no other colour within reach of the blur and is left as it is but for rounding, as its outline against the empty pixels is not an edge. Every covering is kept, and the empty pixels stay empty.

FX-SHARPEN-004.says: Amount 50: each colour pushed half as far from its blur as in FX-SHARPEN-001, wherever neither is held at 0 or 1.

FX-SHARPEN-005.says: Amount 500: each colour pushed five times as far as in FX-SHARPEN-001, held at 0 and 1, so the halos burn: the skin along the line turns white, the skin beside the band a pale yellow, and the whole band pure blue #0000ff; every pixel moves at least as far as in FX-SHARPEN-001, the same way.

FX-SHARPEN-006.says: Radius 0.5: a blur about one pixel wide, so each colour is compared only with its nearest neighbours; the left patch is still left as it is but for rounding.

FX-SHARPEN-007.says: Radius 3: a blur wide enough to reach from the left patch into the box, so the skin of the patch, its blur now darkened by the line, grows lighter too, every pixel of it, most at its soft edge; the covering is kept.

FX-SHARPEN-008.says: Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 200 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 amount 100, FX-SHARPEN-001, and frame 4 amount 200.

FX-SHARPEN-009.says: Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 radius 1, FX-SHARPEN-001, and frame 4 radius 2, whose blur reaches the left patch.

FX-SHARPEN-010.says: Amount eased from 0 at frame 0 to 500 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it has gone past 500 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 are both FX-SHARPEN-005.

FX-SHARPEN-011.says: FX-SHARPEN-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SHARPEN-012.says: Amount 250 and radius 1.5, a strong crisp: every pixel of the box pushed at least as far as in FX-SHARPEN-001, and the wider blur just reaches the patch's right side, faintly: its soft edge in column 3 grows up to about two levels lighter and column 2 under a quarter of a level, while columns 0 and 1 are left as they are but for rounding.

FX-SHARPEN-013.says: Amount 501, above 500. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHARPEN-014.says: Amount -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHARPEN-015.says: Radius 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHARPEN-016.says: Radius -0.5, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHARPEN-017.says: Amount keyed to 600 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHARPEN-018.says: Radius keyed to -2 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
